body: Step 5: self-review mode: main-agent inline review complete

Step 7a: bgjob launch first failed (RuntimeError: missing session owner pid) because LARCH_CLAUDE_PID/LARCH_BGJOB_OWNER_PID were unset in the base env and the step-7a --bgjob-launch fence passes no --owner-pid. Recovered by prefixing LARCH_CLAUDE_PID=$PPID, matching run-step-checks.sh --owner-pid ${LARCH_CLAUDE_PID:-$PPID} fallback.
